scripts.dev: vp run build:package && concurrently -k "vp -C packages/react-submit-flow run dev" "wait-on packages/react-submit-flow/dist/index.js && vp -C apps/website run dev"
scripts.build: vp run build:package && vp run build:website
scripts.typecheck: vp -C packages/react-submit-flow run build:types && vp -C packages/react-submit-flow run typecheck && vp -C apps/website run typecheck
scripts.lint: vp -C packages/react-submit-flow run lint && vp -C apps/website run lint
scripts.check: vp run typecheck && vp run lint && vp run build
